pages.text: Melody Moo is a beautiful young monster girl. She has soft purple fur and two small horns. She lives in a very big building with many bright yellow windows. It is Christmas Eve, and Melody is very happy.

Inside, the house is warm. Melody and her mother, Elara, are decorating the tree. "Has she got the red ornaments?" asks Elara. Melody looks in the box. "Yes, she has!" Melody cries. She hangs a shiny red ball on a branch.

Melody's brother, Barnaby, is in the kitchen. He is a small green monster. He is making a snack. "Has he got a gingerbread man?" Melody asks. "No, he hasn't," says Elara. "He has got a gingerbread monster!" Barnaby laughs and holds up a cookie with three eyes.

Papa Silas is near the fireplace. He is a big monster with a friendly face. Melody helps him. They hang colorful stockings on the wall. "Has the chimney got soot?" asks Melody. Silas looks up. "Yes, it has," he says. "Santa must be careful!"

Elara walks into the room with a green plant. "Has she got the mistletoe?" Melody asks. "Yes, she has!" says Silas. Elara hangs the mistletoe above the door. Melody gives her mother a big monster hug.

Later, Melody and Barnaby go outside. They stand in the snow. They sing loud, happy carols for their neighbors. "Has he got a songbook?" Melody asks about Barnaby. "Yes, he has," she says. They sing, "Fa-la-la-la-moo!"

Suddenly, Melody looks at the dark sky. She sees something fast. It is a big sleigh! "Has it got wheels?" Melody asks Papa Silas. Silas shakes his head. "No, it hasn't. It has got runners for the snow!" The sleigh flies over their big building.

The sleigh is pulled by animals with big antlers. Melody sees one close by. It is a reindeer! "Has it got a red nose?" Melody asks. She looks closely. "No, it hasn't. This reindeer has a brown nose and very soft ears." The reindeer winks at her.

The Monster family sits together. They are very happy. "Have we got a wonderful Christmas?" asks Elara. Silas smiles at his wife. "Yes, we have!" everyone shouts. Melody Moo loves her family and her monster Christmas.
